title: Programming from zero
why: Everything later in the plan assumes you can read and write simple code. This course starts at the very first line, runs in your browser with nothing to install, and finishes with you writing small programs and SQL queries on your own.
outcomes: Read and write variables, lists, dictionaries, loops and functions
Read an error message and fix the line it points to
Move around files and folders in a terminal
Write SELECT queries with WHERE, GROUP BY and JOIN
lessons: Your first lines of code: values, variables and print
Decisions and loops: if, for and while
Functions: name a job once, use it everywhere
The terminal: files, folders and commands
SQL from zero: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY and JOIN
resources: CS50's Introduction to Programming with Python
Watch at 1.25x and do every problem set
Gentle pace if CS50 feels fast
Interactive SQL lessons in the browser
method: Do the in-portal exercises before any video. When you get stuck for ten minutes, open a hint; after three hints, ask the tutor to explain the idea, not the answer. Retype every solution you look at the next day from memory.
build: A small program that reads a list of your weekly study sessions, prints the total hours, the longest session and the average per day, and a SQL query that answers the same question from a table.
